extDescription.message: Watch YouTube without spoilers: hides the progress bar, video length, chapters, comments and recommendations.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

statusOn.description: Popup subtitle while the extension is enabled.

statusOff.description: Popup subtitle while the extension is disabled.

toggleAll.description: Accessible label of the master switch.

featurePlayerHint.message: The red bar and the 3:12 / 1:45:00 readout, also in hover previews

featureDurationsHint.message: Length badges and watch progress on thumbnails

featureChaptersHint.message: Chapter titles and timestamps in the description

featureRecommendationsHint.message: Up next sidebar, end cards and autoplay countdown

featureSeekHint.message: Rewind and skip buttons next to the volume

keyboardTip.message: Keyboard: ← → seek 5 s, J and L seek 10 s.
keyboardTip.description: Popup footer reminding YouTube's built-in shortcuts.

showComments.description: Button that reveals the hidden comments section.

showCommentsWarning.message: Heads up: they may spoil the video.
showCommentsWarning.description: Note under the Show comments button.

seekBackward.description: Accessible label of a rewind button.

seekForward.description: Accessible label of a skip-ahead button.

seekStepsLegend.description: Label above the seek step picker.

seekStepsHint.message: Pick up to $MAX$. Each one adds a − and a + button.
seekStepsHint.description: Hint under the seek step picker.
